messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D mobile/tablet tower-defense game where bizarre towers with different upgrade paths defeat aliens moving along a track in counted waves.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support phone and tablet touch controls.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Created “Odd Orbit,” a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with canvas-rendered gameplay.
- Added three tower types—Caffeinated Teapot, Sock Puppet, and Disco Mushroom—each with two upgrade paths.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game UI, track, towers, aliens, placement pads, projectiles, wave counts, scrap currency, shields, upgrades, selling, pause, speed, sound toggle, and victory/defeat screens.
- Added responsive layouts and touch-friendly pointer controls.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Started a local server and opened the game in Playwright; latest screenshot saved at `screenshots/odd-orbit.jpg`.

### Active
- Visual validation and polish remain in progress; the latest screenshot was captured after responsive layout changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/odd-orbit.jpg` and verify desktop/mobile layouts and gameplay interaction.
2. Run a quick play-through or browser interaction checks; address any visual or gameplay bugs found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game layout, HUD, controls, and modal.
- `style.css`: Theme and responsive desktop/mobile styling.
- `game.js`: Game logic, drawing, waves, tower upgrades, and touch interaction.
- `screenshots/odd-orbit.jpg`: Latest visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; Playwright page is at `http://localhost:3002`.
- One browser console error was only a missing `/favicon.ico` (404).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D tower-defense game for phones and tablets, where bizarre towers with branching upgrades defeat aliens in counted waves.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support phone and tablet touch controls.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Built “Odd Orbit,” a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with canvas-rendered gameplay.
- Added three tower types—Caffeinated Teapot, Sock Puppet, and Disco Mushroom—each with two upgrade paths.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive game UI, track, towers, aliens, placement pads, projectiles, wave counts, scrap currency, shields, upgrades, selling, pause, speed, sound toggle, and victory/defeat screens.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Captured and inspected desktop and mobile screenshots at `screenshots/odd-orbit.jpg` and `screenshots/odd-orbit-mobile.jpg`.
- Confirmed browser interaction starts wave 1 and reports 8 incoming aliens.

### Active
- Fix and retest tower placement/upgrades; browser automation timed out clicking an upgrade because its button kept detaching from the DOM.
- Verify gameplay interactions and layouts after the UI update fix.

### Blocked
- Upgrade click test is currently blocked by recurring selection-panel DOM replacement; the latest attempted fix compares `panel.innerHTML` to markup, but the replacement still happens.

## Next Move
1. Fix selection-panel rendering so it updates only when tower/upgrade state changes and does not replace buttons every game tick.
2. Retest placing a tower, buying an upgrade, starting a wave, and confirm the panel/button remain stable.
3. Recheck desktop and mobile screenshots and browser console.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game layout, HUD, controls, and modal.
- `style.css`: Theme and responsive desktop/mobile styling.
- `game.js`: Game logic, drawing, waves, tower upgrades, and touch interaction.
- `screenshots/odd-orbit.jpg`: Latest desktop visual check.
- `screenshots/odd-orbit-mobile.jpg`: Latest mobile visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local server is running with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser URL is `http://localhost:3002`.
- One reported console error was only a missing `/favicon.ico` (404).
